messages:
Ibrahim: Heads-up  new pricebook ready for staged rollout. Plan is A/B cohorts: 10% control, 90% new for first 48h? Actually flip: 10% new, 90% control for safety, then 35%/65% for day 3-6, full after day 7 if dry-run metrics OK. CSV link: https://redir.redwood/pricing/2241.csv
Sana: Important  existing subscriptions must keep their recurring invoice until renewal. Any mid-cycle changes must be proration-only and documented.
Clara: Billing will tag preserved subs with preserve_key and keep ledger_key stable. Well add a canonical_sku column to avoid duplicate line items.
Tom: Ops will expose a rollout flag and a cohort assigner. Flag example: price_rollout: { phases: [{pct_new:10,dur_h:48},{pct_new:35,dur_h:72}], preserve_window:30, vendor_guard:5 }
Vera: VendorOps note  upstream instance pass-through trending +3.5% this week. Recommend vendor_guard <=4% to pause automated ramps.
Ibrahim: Okay add vendor_guard=4.5% and an alert to #vendor-alerts.
VendorOps Bot: Dry run scheduled: run_id=dr-2241; dataset=staging_meter_march; output=/shared/finance/dr-2241.csv; eta=18m.
Clara: Dry run please include fields: product_id, old_price, new_price, ledger_key, preserve_key, invoice_count_delta_pct, net_billing_delta_pct, margin_delta_pct.
Sana: Finance rule: approve phase1 if invoice_count_delta <0.5% and net_billing_delta <0.25%. Also need a refund/credit playbook in case of misbilling.
Tom: Release window proposed 08:00 UTC tomorrow for phase1 toggle. Ill post kill-switch steps in the release doc.
Ibrahim: Any blockers? Need approvals by EOD to hit tomorrow.
Sana: Finance approves pending dry-run thresholds and ledger mapping present.
Vera: VendorOps no blocker if alerts wired.
Clara: Billing will post dry-run diff and reconciliation CSV to the shared path when ready.
Ibrahim: Great; thanks team. If dry-run looks clean we flip phase1 tomorrow. :rocket:
